text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ

words.gloss_range: connector that binds the negated motive clause to the prior giving scene, with resumptive, circumstantial, and boundary force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle opening the denial governed by the connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 92:19 attached to the act of giving just described in 92:18. It can be heard as resuming the explanation and as making the new clause a circumstance of that giving, so the ayah does not become a detached maxim. Because the connector is fused directly to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), the first move is a linked denial: the giver's action is immediately shielded from being read as repayment.

topics.headline: connector binds giving to motive-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah explains the motive of the prior giving instead of starting an unrelated statement.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a conjunction, and the local clause is a negated nominal possession clause that follows the giving scene from 92:18.

topics.headline: connector and negator launch one block
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears linkage and denial arrive together, so the ayah's opening excludes the repayment reading before any claimant is named.
topics.reason: The surface sequence joins the conjunction to the negative particle, and attachment evidence gives the negation scope over the whole possession clause.

topics.headline: open sound carries the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the boundary as a glide into negation rather than a hard reset after the previous ayah.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is anchored in the local opening sequence and supports the syntactic continuity already established.

words.gloss_range: negative particle governing the whole nominal possession clause and, with the later particle, making the denial exhaustive

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: post-negation particle that reinforces the total absence of any favor
passive recompense verb reached by the negation's scope

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) is the governing denial for the whole clause. It does not merely negate one nearby word; it covers the possible claimant, the account-location, the favor, and the passive repayment process. Its later pairing with {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the denial exhaustive, so 92:19 clears the field before 92:20 names the only remaining motive.

topics.headline: negation governs the whole transaction frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees claimant, location, favor, and recompense as one denied transaction-frame, not as separate loosely negated details.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the clause as a negated nominal possession clause and explicitly warns that the negation covers the existence of any recompensable favor.

topics.headline: paired particles make the denial exhaustive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies even one possible favor-credit, not merely a particular repayment.
topics.reason: The local attachment evidence marks the later particle after negation as the negative-polarity construction governing the favor noun.

topics.headline: negative particle, not relative or interrogative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the clause as a denial of motive, not as a question or a relative expression.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a negative particle, and the following post-negation particle supports negative rather than relative or interrogative parsing.

topics.headline: negation prepares the next ayah's exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 92:19 removes rival motives before 92:20 supplies the exception.
topics.reason: The local negation excludes every recompensable favor, creating a grammatical and semantic setup for the following exception in 92:20.

topics.headline: the passive ending remains under the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening denial reaches all the way to the passive ending, so the uncertainty about what is repaid stays inside one exclusion.
topics.reason: The passive clause modifies the favor within the same negated clause, so the final repayment verb is not outside the opening particle's scope.

words.gloss_range: preposition forming the fronted possession or claim-holder predicate under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the indefinite claimant governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the first nominal target after the negator a possession or claim relation. The phrase with {{ar:أَحَدٍ}} ({{tr:aḥadin}}) stands before the delayed favor, so the ayah first rules out any holder of a claim and only afterward names the favor that could have generated debt. The clitic form compresses that denied ownership into the anonymous person itself.

topics.headline: fronted predicate denies the holder first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claimant is denied before the favor is named, so the sentence first empties the ownership slot.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase as the fronted predicate in the negated nominal clause, with the favor as delayed subject.

topics.headline: possession relation is introduced only as denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah blocks a proprietary claim, not merely a direction of giving.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the indefinite claimant and creates the possession or specialization relation that the negation denies.

topics.headline: the particle assigns a claim-holder role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following person is not an actor but the hypothetical holder of a claim that the ayah erases.
topics.reason: The governed noun is a prepositional complement rather than a verbal subject or agent, so the local role is possible claim-holder under negation.

topics.headline: bound preposition marks the claimant entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the denied possession relation arrive at the same instant as the anonymous claimant.
topics.reason: The particle is bound to the following indefinite noun, and the sound observation is local to that surface sequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular under negation meaning any possible claimant, governed as a genitive complement in the denied possession phrase
words.root_gloss_range: oneness, singularity, and uniqueness; local negative-polarity syntax turns singularity into anonymous universality rather than honorific uniqueness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing the claimant as a denied possessor
the following account-location tied to the denied claimant field
the negative particle that gives the indefinite claimant universal scope

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدٍ}} ({{tr:aḥadin}}) is a singular indefinite, but under {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) it becomes universal: not one possible claimant remains. Governed by {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), it is not an actor in the scene but a hypothetical holder of a favor-credit, and the following account-location makes that anonymous claimant feel like a possible ledger-holder before the ledger is emptied. The root's oneness pressure therefore works distributively here, testing each possible single claimant and excluding all of them; honorific uniqueness, such as the use in 112:1, is not imported into this social slot. The surah-local contrast with created totality in 92:3 stays bounded: the point here is not creation but the denial that any single person holds a repayment claim. Even the glottal onset gives the claimant's entry a slight audible arrest inside the negated frame.

topics.headline: indefinite singular becomes universal under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah excludes every possible individual claimant by denying even one.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word indefinite and genitive, while the contextual profile shows this exact form strongly associated with negative-polarity use.

topics.headline: claimant is governed as a denied holder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the possible person as a claim-holder erased by the sentence, not as someone acting in the repayment scene.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the fused preposition in the fronted predicate phrase, and the later passive clause has the favor as its controlled subject in the primary reading.

topics.headline: oneness pressure becomes distributive anonymity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the force of singularity as the exclusion of each possible one, while local grammar keeps the sense at anonymous anyone.
topics.reason: The root's broader uniqueness field is relevant as pressure, but local negative-polarity syntax selects distributive anyone rather than a unifying verb or honorific title.

topics.headline: noun-numeral form keeps a countable claimant slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is built from countable single persons rather than from a named group.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a noun-numeral form rather than a verbal or adjectival form, matching the claimant slot created by the preposition.

topics.headline: claimant moves into account-location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees anonymous universality become concrete as a possible account-holder near the giver before that ledger is emptied.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the governed claimant to the suffixed account-location and then to the favor noun.

topics.headline: divine uniqueness contrast stays contrastive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between honorific oneness in 112:1 and the anonymous human claimant erased here.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah contrast is useful, but local grammar and referent behavior keep this occurrence in a generic human claimant role, not a divine-title role.

topics.headline: surah-local creation contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can contrast the created totality recalled from 92:3 with the denial that any single person holds a repayment claim here.
topics.reason: The row supplies a concrete surah-local contrast; it should not control the local parse, but it can remain as a bounded echo.

topics.headline: glottal onset marks the claimant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a perceptible stop as the anonymous claimant enters the negated frame.
topics.reason: The sound note is locally anchored in the initial onset of the word and supports the entry of the claimant slot.

topics.headline: negation, possession, and delay converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is anonymous, universal, possessive, and empty at once before the favor arrives.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the possession preposition, scoped by negation, and placed before the delayed favor-object.

words.gloss_range: suffixed locative adverb meaning with him or in his account-domain, locally locating the denied favor-credit
words.root_gloss_range: presence, nearness, account-like at-ness, and separate branches of resistance or stubbornness; local grammar selects suffixed locative presence while resistance remains only a bounded image-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ʿindahu}}) turns the denied claim into a located account-space. The suffix makes the location specific: the syntactic antecedent is the giver from 92:17, while the familiar account-language of being with someone or with God remains a bounded pressure rather than a replacement for that antecedent. Placed between the anonymous claimant and the favor, the word lets the reader imagine where a repayable credit would be stored, then the following denial empties that place. The resistance branch survives only as the image of a claim that could sit fixed and enforceable in that account-space, while the local adverb keeps the selected sense locative. The nasal cluster around this word and the following favor phrase also makes location and denied favor sound like one transaction unit.

topics.headline: suffix makes the account-location specific
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied favor is not floating in abstraction but is located in a specific account-domain.
topics.reason: QAC marks a suffixed adverb of place, and attachment evidence treats the suffix as the possessor or complement of the locative word.

topics.headline: giver antecedent is primary while divine account pressure remains bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the suffix first to the giver while still sensing the wider account-register that can make divine reckoning hover in the background.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly links the suffix to the giver from 92:17, so a divine-account possibility can survive only as formulaic pressure, not as the controlling local antecedent.

topics.headline: nearness becomes ledger-location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees debt as something that would be with or near the giver, not as direct physical possession.
topics.reason: The local word is an adverbial locative modifying the favor, and V4 includes presence or proximity as an accepted branch for the root.

topics.headline: stubbornness branch colors only the stored-claim image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the possible claim as something fixed or resistant, while local form keeps the selected meaning at locative account-domain.
topics.reason: V4 separates resistance branches from locative presence, and QAC marks the local word as an adverb rather than an adjective of stubbornness.

topics.headline: spatial nearness becomes stored obligation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the clause makes a debt relation spatial before denying that any such credit is there.
topics.reason: The word sits immediately before the favor noun and is licensed as the adverbial location of that favor.

topics.headline: with-someone recompense formula is inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes an account-register often associated with what is held with God, but here it is redirected through a pronoun and negated.
topics.reason: The distribution often links the adverb to divine referents, but local cross-reference evidence keeps the actual suffix tied to the giver; the formula therefore survives as contrastive account-register only.

topics.headline: middle position maps the transaction-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader moves from possible claimant to account-location to favor, so the repayment economy is mapped before it is denied.
topics.reason: The adverbial is structurally placed between the governed claimant and the favor noun within one negated clause.

topics.headline: nasal cluster binds location to favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears location and denied favor draw together as one transaction cluster.
topics.reason: The sound note is anchored in the local sequence from this word through the following particle and favor noun.

words.gloss_range: post-negation particle governing the indefinite favor noun, semantically reinforcing exhaustive absence rather than adding a separate source sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the indefinite favor noun governed by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is syntactically extra in the negative-polarity construction, but it is not semantically empty. It makes the denial exhaustive: not even one favor-unit is present as a possible repayment claim. Because it stands immediately before {{ar:نِّعْمَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:niʿmatin}}), the totalizing force lands exactly where the delayed debt-object is finally named, after the clause has already stacked negator, claimant, and account-location. Inside the movement from the positive giving of 92:18 into motive-denial, this particle is the internal marker that makes the exclusion exhaustive.

topics.headline: post-negation particle intensifies total absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies any favor whatsoever, not merely a particular favor.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the particle after negation as a negative-polarity construction governing the favor noun and warns against lexicalizing it as an independent source preposition.

topics.headline: the particle introduces the delayed debt-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause stack negator, claimant, location, and then totalized favor before the passive repayment closes it.
topics.reason: The particle directly precedes the delayed favor noun in a clause whose earlier elements have already denied the claimant and account-location.

topics.headline: nasal binding makes totalization audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the totalizing particle bind to the first sound of the denied favor.
topics.reason: The surface sequence places the particle immediately before the geminated opening of the favor noun.

topics.headline: internal marker shifts from action to motive-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior positive giving answered by a layered internal denial of what did not motivate it.
topics.reason: The particle is the internal marker that makes the negated motive frame exhaustive after the giving described in 92:18.

words.gloss_range: one countable favor or benefit under exhaustive negation, functioning as the delayed subject and as the debt-object modified by the passive recompense clause
words.root_gloss_range: favor, bounty, pleasant well-being, comfort, excellence, affirmation, and livestock or wealth registers; local noun selects favor-benefit while material and comfort branches survive as bounded concreteness pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the post-negation particle that totalizes the favor noun
the passive modifier defining the favor as something that would be recompensed

words.prose: {{ar:نِّعْمَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:niʿmatin}}) is the delayed subject of the negated clause, yet it is genitive under {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}), so its case serves the totalizing denial while its role supplies the thing denied. The singular indefinite makes the point sharper: even one countable favor-credit is absent. The root field keeps the favor concrete through benefit, comfort, bestowal, and even material wealth registers, but the local noun is not generic bliss; it is a would-be debt item immediately qualified by {{ar:تُجْزَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:tujza}}). That concreteness keeps the divine-bestowal contrast with 1:7 bounded and visible: here the same benefit field is narrowed into a humanly recompensable favor only to deny it. It also ties the word into the surah-local good and wealth thread, from confirmed good in 92:6 through unavailing wealth in 92:11 and the wealth given in 92:18, while the doubled opening sound thickens the point where the totalizing particle lands.

topics.headline: delayed subject bears genitive negation marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the favor is logically central but arrives late already marked by exhaustive denial.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the prepositional phrase as the predicate and the favor as the delayed subject governed by the post-negation particle.

topics.headline: the favor is defined as recompensable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the favor only as a would-be repaid object, not as a free-standing blessing topic.
topics.reason: The passive verb is a verbal adjective clause modifying the favor, with 3fs agreement controlled by the favor noun.

topics.headline: singular indefinite makes one debt-unit absent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies even the smallest countable favor that could become a ledger item.
topics.reason: The noun is singular, indefinite, and governed by the post-negation particle, so countability strengthens rather than weakens the total denial.

topics.headline: comfort and bestowal keep the favor concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that what is denied is a real benefit or benefaction that could claim repayment, while local grammar keeps it as a favor noun.
topics.reason: V4 supports favor, comfort, and bestowal branches, but the local surface is a noun in the debt-object position rather than a verb of bestowing or comfort-making.

topics.headline: livestock and wealth register sharpens the 92:18 boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the wealth given in 92:18 is not being balanced against a material favor-credit in 92:19.
topics.reason: V4 includes a livestock or wealth register for the root, but the local noun selects favor-benefit; the material register survives only as concrete pressure against a repayment reading.

topics.headline: favor becomes the affected item of repayment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repayment economy itself is negated at the object level: no favor is available to undergo recompense.
topics.reason: The passive verb's unexpressed 3fs subject is controlled by the favor noun, making the favor the affected item in the primary reading.

topics.headline: noun form turns benefaction into a ledger item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies an object-like favor-credit rather than narrating a giver's act of bestowal.
topics.reason: The local form is an abstract noun in the negated clause, not a verbal bestowal form.

topics.headline: divine gift field contrasts with human favor-credit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root can point toward divine bestowal, as in 1:7, but here that field is narrowed into a humanly recompensable favor only to deny it.
topics.reason: The broader blessing field is valid, but local negation, the claimant phrase, and the passive recompense modifier make this occurrence a denied debt-object rather than a general divine blessing claim.

topics.headline: surah-local good and wealth thread becomes denied favor-credit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the confirmed good of 92:6 and the wealth motif of 92:11 and 92:18 to the favor-credit that is denied here.
topics.reason: The row family supplies concrete surah-local references, but they function as bounded thematic echoes rather than as replacements for the local favor sense.

topics.headline: geminated opening receives the totalizing particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denied favor thicken at the sound where the totalizing particle lands.
topics.reason: The sound observation is anchored in the doubled opening consonant of the local favor noun after the particle.

topics.headline: broad benefit registers are locally compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the root's benefit range while seeing the ayah compress that range into one negated favor-unit.
topics.reason: The root has multiple accepted registers, but local singular indefiniteness and the post-negation construction license only a bounded favor-unit here.

words.gloss_range: 3fs imperfect passive recompense or requital, modifying the favor and denying any ongoing repayment process without naming a repayer
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, requital, reward, punishment, equivalent return, discharge or sufficing, debt-collection, and tribute-payment; local passive selects recompense or settlement of obligation under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the favor noun controlled as the passive subject in the primary reading

words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:tujza}}) closes the ayah on the process being denied. In the primary reading, its feminine agreement ties it to {{ar:نِّعْمَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:niʿmatin}}), so the favor itself is the thing that would be recompensed; the variant pressure shows that the same clause can be felt at the role boundary between favor and claimant, while the local surface keeps the favor centered. The imperfect passive leaves repayment as a contemplated process but removes the repayer from view; no human or divine agent is named to settle the account. The root covers equivalent return, reward, punishment, debt-settlement, and tribute-like obligation, while this marked deagentivized local form rejects that whole exchange logic as the motive for the giver's action. That rejection echoes a wider refusal-of-return field through passive negation rather than explicit desire language, contrasts external repayment with the self-purifying giving of 92:18 and the path movement of 92:10, and clears the field for the sole remaining motive in 92:20. The final long closure lets the denied repayment linger as the ayah's landing point.

topics.headline: feminine passive agrees with the favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the primary reading denies a favor being repaid, not simply a person being rewarded.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as 3fs passive, and attachment evidence says the unexpressed passive subject is controlled by the favor noun.

topics.headline: passive removes the repayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader focuses on the absent transaction rather than on identifying a repaying agent.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly leaves the passive agent unexpressed and warns against adding a recovered agent in translation.

topics.headline: imperfect passive denies ongoing repayment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears repayment as a possible process under consideration and then excluded as motive.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect passive form, and the local negation scopes over the passive modifier.

topics.headline: variant agreement tests person versus favor as patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause's pressure point: the denied recompense can be centered on the favor in the primary reading or on the claimant in the variant.
topics.reason: The accepted variant can illuminate the role-pressure, while the aligned local surface remains the feminine form controlled by the favor noun.

topics.headline: root excludes the logic of equivalent return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah rejects the whole equivalence-return logic, whether reward-like or punitive, not just friendly repayment.
topics.reason: V4 includes recompense, requital, reward, punishment, and reciprocal return as accepted branches of the root.

topics.headline: the favor is foregrounded while agency disappears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ledger image close around an affected favor while the repaying side of the transaction vanishes.
topics.reason: The passive frame has no explicit object or agent, and the surrounding phrase supplies the favor as the controlled passive subject.

topics.headline: debt and tribute branches sharpen settlement rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a social settlement edge behind the recompense verb, while local grammar keeps the selected sense at passive repayment under negation.
topics.reason: V4 supports obligation-settlement, debt-collection, and tribute branches, but the local passive imperfect does not stage a mutual Form III exchange or a specific tribute event.

topics.headline: marked passive form supports non-expectation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the common recompense root appearing in a marked deagentivized form at the point where repayment is denied.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the exact passive imperfect form as a minority pattern within a broader recompense root profile.

topics.headline: non-recompense formula echoed through passive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Quranic refusal-of-return field, while this ayah expresses it through passive negation rather than explicit desire language.
topics.reason: The root connection is coherent, but the local form is a passive modifier under negation, not a direct quoted statement of desire.

topics.headline: hardship path and giving motive are contrasted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 92:19 contrast external repayment with the self-purifying giving of 92:18 and the surah's path language in 92:10.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete surah-local references, but they remain thematic and boundary contrasts rather than alternate local syntax.

topics.headline: ayah lands on denied recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is left at the end of the ayah hearing the very repayment process that has been negated.
topics.reason: The word is the final surface unit of the ayah, and its written ending supports the local cadence observation.

topics.headline: negated repayment prepares the exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repayment field cleared so 92:20 can introduce the sole remaining motive.
topics.reason: The final passive recompense verb remains within the negated clause and sets up the following exception by excluding repayment.

topics.headline: voice, subject role, and boundary contrast converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final verb as the convergence point where person, favor, omitted agent, and exchange-economy are all excluded.
topics.reason: The passive verb closes the negated clause, suppresses the agent, and in the primary reading assigns the passive subject role to the favor while variant evidence exposes the person/favor role-pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exhaustive construction ما لأحد ... من نعمة and the passive تُجزى bind every possible claimant and every favor into a repayment relation, then negate that relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bestowed benefit can remain present with its recipient as another person's credit. The focus construction clears the giver's whole interpersonal ledger: no such credit is present and no matching return is being made.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone extends the negation across every possible human claimant.
Proximity and presence make a prior favor something that could still stand with him as an outstanding credit.
Bestowed benefaction supplies the antecedent good that could generate obligation.
Matched requital supplies the return that the negated favor would otherwise demand.

changed_reading.before: The act may simply be generous while also answering a benefactor.
changed_reading.after: The sentence performs a total ledger-clearing: not even one person's prior benefaction is being answered by this act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive تُجزى can describe not only reward but something standing in for, availing, or settling a due; لأحد and عنده locate the denied beneficiary and claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor could function as consideration that discharges an obligation or as a collectible debt. The negation excludes both substitution and collection, so the act is not a device for closing someone else's account.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone leaves no creditor for whom a discharge could operate.
Presence with him spatializes the place where a claim or countervalue would be held.
A bestowed favor provides the possible consideration in the transaction.
Standing in and sufficing recasts recompense as substitute performance or discharge.
Debt collection keeps live the sharper legal image of a claim being pursued and settled.

changed_reading.before: No one is being rewarded for a favor.
changed_reading.after: No favor in his account is serving as substitute payment, discharging a due, or satisfying a collectible human claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root inventory behind نعمة permits an image of adding or going beyond, while تُجزى supplies reciprocal balancing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor can be imagined as surplus added beyond what was due. If recompense restores equivalence, the focus negation says the giver is not balancing an earlier surplus bestowed by anyone.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive negation prevents any person from being the source of the supposed surplus.
Adding and going further supplies the exploratory image of favor as an increment beyond baseline obligation.
Matching requital would bring that prior increment back into balance.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies repayment of an ordinary kindness.
changed_reading.after: It also denies an equalizing response to any extra increment that a person had previously placed above what was due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering followed by disclosure turns the focus's legal negation into an exposure of motive: a visible gift could cover a hidden debt, but the sentence brings the absence of that debt into view.

activation_trace.role: Presence with him supplies the potentially hidden internal account.
Requital identifies the concealed transactional motive whose absence is disclosed.
A cover rising over and concealing something models the outward gift masking an inward account.
Disclosure and appearance model the focus sentence as uncovering what actually drives the act.

structural_cues: The opening sequence places night-covering immediately against day-disclosure before any human action is classified.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering and disclosure; I apply their contrast to motive and account visibility. A live alternative is that they remain only cosmic framing and add no psychological layer.

changed_reading.before: The focus states the objective absence of a debt.
changed_reading.after: The focus also functions as disclosure: beneath the visible transfer there is no concealed human repayment ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measurement, earning activity, and dispersed strivings make recompense look like an operation that measures one act against another. The focus removes this giver's act from that human commensuration system.

activation_trace.role: A bestowed favor is the candidate input to a measured exchange.
Matching an act with its requital supplies the commensurating operation.
Estimating and measuring supplies the image of calibrated equivalence.
Work and earning place human action inside an economy of effort and return.
Dispersion prevents the diverse strivings from collapsing into one uniform exchange pattern.

structural_cues: Created pairing is followed by the assertion that human striving is diverse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, work or earning, dispersion, and matched recompense; I infer a shared question of commensurability. Alternatively, the creation and striving cues may classify lives without specifying an exchange metric.

changed_reading.before: One particular prior kindness is not being repaid.
changed_reading.after: This striving is not calibrated as a wage-like counter-act within the many divergent economies of human effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving is sequenced with self-protection, enacted verification of the good, and opening into ease. This reverses the focus's denied backward arrow: the transfer does not look back to a human favor but works forward as truthful, protective movement.

activation_trace.role: Prior benefaction supplies the backward-looking cause that the focus excludes.
Matched return defines the retrospective transaction being reversed.
Handover and giving supply the outward act whose direction is at issue.
Placing oneself in protection gives the act a prospective rather than compensatory function.
Fulfilling a promise in action makes giving verification rather than repayment.
The good opposed to ugliness supplies the value being verified.
Opening into ease supplies the forward consequence of the protective trajectory.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from giving, through guarding and verification, to future facilitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies this ordered sequence; I infer a causal arrow from giving through protection and verification toward ease. The live alternative is that these are coordinated traits and consequence, without giving itself causing the protection.

changed_reading.before: The transfer is defined mainly by the prior favor it does not repay.
changed_reading.after: The transfer faces forward: it enacts truth and enters a protective path toward ease, while refusing a backward human claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stingy figure claims independence while retaining wealth, yet wealth cannot avail at the fall. Against that pattern, the focus's absence of human debt becomes relational freedom rather than possessive self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone clears every human patron or creditor from the giver's motive.
Sufficing or availing distinguishes genuine release from dependence from merely possessing means.
Stinginess supplies the rival strategy of securing oneself by withholding.
Claimed wealth and independence name the rival's apparent freedom.
Sufficiency and availing are explicitly negated for wealth at the crisis point.
Accumulated wealth supplies the retained asset that fails to liberate its holder.
Falling into ruin supplies the event at which possessive independence proves false.

structural_cues: The withholding and self-sufficiency pair is later answered by the statement that wealth does not avail when its holder falls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false self-sufficiency and failed wealth; I infer that the focus offers a different freedom, release from human claims while giving. Alternatively, the focus may negate motive only and make no positive claim about freedom.

changed_reading.before: Having no debt sounds like being independently self-sufficient.
changed_reading.after: The giver's freedom is the opposite of self-enclosed wealth: he is free of human patronage precisely while letting wealth go.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance and gift coexist in the same context-root inventory, while the context assigns guidance to a non-human علينا. The focus can therefore clear horizontal repayment without making the act causeless: responsiveness to guidance remains live even when response to a human benefactor is denied.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone supplies the cleared field of personal claimants.
Bestowed favor names the antecedent whose human ownership is denied.
Requital marks the horizontal response that is excluded.
Gentle direction toward the way supplies a possible antecedent for the giver's course.
A gift sent to one beloved makes guidance itself available as a non-commercial giving image.

structural_cues: The context says that guidance is upon علينا before it describes the two human outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine-assigned guidance and a guidance-or-gift branch; I infer vertical responsiveness without a horizontal creditor. A live alternative is that أحد is unrestricted and the act responds to no antecedent gift at all, only pursues a goal.

changed_reading.before: No prior favor means the act has no antecedent to which it responds.
changed_reading.after: The verse may deny every human debt while leaving the giver responsive to guidance understood as direction or gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: A favor normally begins a transaction and delayed recompense closes it. The context's first, later, and return-to-outcome images enlarge that chronology, strengthening the claim that no human first cause owns the giver's later act.

activation_trace.role: A prior benefaction supplies the possible beginning of the interpersonal loop.
Requital supplies the later act that would close the loop.
Deferral to a later time sharpens the temporal gap between favor and repayment.
Beginning and precedence supply the first end of the transaction.
Return to outcome supplies the closure toward which an act tends.

structural_cues: The context joins the later and the first under one possession statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firstness, delay, and eventual outcome; I map them onto the temporal loop of favor then repayment. Alternatively, the first-and-last claim may concern domains rather than the chronology of motive.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies a single present debt.
changed_reading.after: It denies an entire human time-loop in which an earlier benefactor becomes the owner of the giver's later action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning, encounter with fire, turning away, and being kept aside establish a consequence system larger than interpersonal exchange. Since recompense can include good or evil return, the focus now distinguishes cosmic consequence from social repayment rather than denying every consequence.

activation_trace.role: Reward or punishment within requital supplies the broad consequence category that needs differentiation.
Warning that awakens caution announces consequential stakes.
Kindled fire supplies the punitive pole of consequence.
Encountering fire and its heat makes consequence experiential rather than merely contractual.
Turning away supplies the antecedent orientation of the punitive path.
Being distanced and kept apart supplies the positive figure's opposite outcome.
Self-protection connects the protected figure to the earlier forward-looking path.

structural_cues: The warning-to-fire chain for the denier is immediately reversed by the protected figure being kept away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed consequence paths; I infer that the broad recompense branch lets the focus distinguish those consequences from repayment owed to a person. The alternative is narrower: تُجزى may refer only to debt settlement here.

changed_reading.before: The verse could sound as if the giver expects no return of any kind.
changed_reading.after: It denies repayment to a human benefactor while remaining compatible with a larger moral consequence, protection, or reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth moves outward through giving while growth and purification occur in the giver. The focus therefore separates reciprocal return from transformative return: nothing comes back from a human beneficiary, yet the act changes and enlarges its source.

activation_trace.role: Adding and going further lets favor be tested against a different, non-equivalent kind of increase.
Matched requital supplies the reciprocal return explicitly excluded.
Giving supplies the outward movement of value.
Possessed wealth supplies what leaves the giver's control.
Growth and increase supply a return that is generative rather than paid by another person.
Purity and rectification locate the act's effect in transformation of the giver.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding ayah says that he gives his wealth while undergoing self-directed purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward wealth-giving and growth or purity; I call the latter a transformative return while denying reciprocal payment. A live alternative is that purification names intention alone and should not be treated as an outcome.

changed_reading.before: If no favor is repaid, the gift has no return.
changed_reading.after: No value returns from a human creditor, but the outward loss of wealth can coincide with inward growth and purification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception after the focus supplies a vector: seeking, face or direction, lordship, and elevation reroute the act away from a nearby human creditor toward a higher object. Motivation becomes orientation rather than exchange.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone clears every person from the destination of repayment.
Nearness and presence locate the rejected human center of account.
Requital supplies the exchange vector being displaced.
Active seeking supplies purposive motion beyond the cleared human ledger.
Direction and orientation give the act a destination rather than a counterparty.
Face as self or essence preserves the personal object of seeking without making it a commercial creditor.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the non-human pole toward which the act is directed.
Elevation turns the horizontal account into an upwardly oriented relation.

structural_cues: The following ayah begins with an exception and then names seeking, face, lordship, and the highest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exception and directional images; I infer a vector from proximate human credit toward the Lord. وجه may instead denote divine self or presence rather than spatial direction, but that alternative still preserves non-transactional orientation.

changed_reading.before: The verse only subtracts a human motive.
changed_reading.after: It clears a horizontal exchange so that the act can be read positively as directed seeking toward the highest Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Matched recompense closes an account by equivalence, whereas future satisfaction or acceptance is qualitative and potentially abundant. The final cue prevents no-repayment from becoming no-outcome.

activation_trace.role: Matched requital supplies the finite equivalence that closes a debt.
Sufficing and settling sharpen the image of a completed account.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies an open qualitative endpoint in place of exact repayment.

structural_cues: A future-marked satisfaction statement closes the sequence after the focus negation and its purpose exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future satisfaction; I contrast its qualitative endpoint with the equivalence of recompense. A live alternative is that satisfaction names a received reward, not an inward transformation, and so remains closer to consequence.

changed_reading.before: Refusing human repayment leaves the act without an anticipated completion.
changed_reading.after: The anticipated completion is satisfaction or acceptance rather than an equivalent counterpayment from a beneficiary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the livestock branch of نعمة with the non-dominant ج ز ز mapping behind تُجزى and then lets context growth activate shearing or harvest. It remains packet-anchored at both focus words and two growth cues, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy, never a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventories themselves permit favor as livestock and the split mapping of تُجزى as cutting or shearing; the negation can therefore host an anti-harvest image.

activation_trace.role: Grazing livestock materializes the favor as a productive herd-like asset.
The non-dominant cutting and shearing branch turns repayment into taking yield off an asset.
Increase and productive flow in sheep activate the herd's capacity to yield.
Growth and increase make harvesting that yield materially imaginable.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an abstract balancing payment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the giver is not shearing a beneficiary's prior bounty for yield; the act releases wealth without harvesting a human return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it spatializes social obligation through individual separation, sideward standing, dispersion, and side-positioning. It remains anchored in أحد and عنده and is reinforced by context branches, but it should be rendered only as a social-spatial model of patronage, not as a replacement dictionary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins exhaustive individuality with something being present at his side, allowing a denied network of person-by-person side accounts.

activation_trace.role: Individual-by-individual distribution atomizes the possible patrons.
Sideward standing and separation picture each patron's claim as a side account.
Debt collection gives those side accounts a concrete social claim.
Dispersion multiplies the field into distinct, potentially competing accounts.
Side and flank imagery reinforces the spatial model while the context's passive removal breaks the network.

changed_reading.before: No single benefactor has a claim.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the giver has no distributed patronage network stored in person-by-person side accounts that his gift must service.

strongest_changes: The surrounding sequence reverses the temporal arrow from backward repayment toward forward protection, verification, ease, and purification.
Guidance as both direction and gift allows human debtlessness to coexist with vertical responsiveness.
Giving wealth while growing or purifying distinguishes reciprocal return from transformative return.
The purpose exception reroutes the act from a nearby human creditor toward seeking the face of the highest Lord.
Future satisfaction replaces exact equivalence as the act's possible completion.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact legal-spatial construction did not stay a simple sincerity formula. Context activated visibility, commensurability, temporal direction, two kinds of freedom, vertical response, transformative outflow, and qualitative completion. The split ج ز ي mapping also generated a contained pastoral anti-harvest reading that would disappear under conservative synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أحد should be restricted to human claimants in the vertical-response model or read without that qualification.
Who is understood to perform the passive recompense and how tightly تُجزى modifies نعمة.
Whether growth and purification are consequences of giving or coordinated descriptions of its manner.
How much interpretive weight the form-distant surplus, livestock, and shearing branches can bear.
Whether the final satisfaction is chiefly inward contentment, acceptance, or received consequence.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **No repayable favor in anyone’s possession.** Evidence: `ء ح د` B002 (negative exhaustive anyone), `ع ن د` B004 (presence/at-ness), `ن ع م` B001 (favor/blessing), `ج ز ي` B001 (recompense matching act). Structural cue: the negation removes human creditors before 92:20 names the sought face. Mechanism: his giving is detached from an account payable to any person. Abductive move: I infer a creditor ledger being explicitly emptied. Reading change: the ayah defines purity as freedom from reciprocal social debt.

2. **Standing-in denied.** Evidence: `ج ز ي` B002 (standing in/sufficing), activated by `غ ن ي` B002 in 92:11. Structural cue: the failed sufficing of wealth is mirrored by unrecompensed favor. Mechanism: no prior favor stands in as the hidden cause of his giving. Abductive move: I infer that the verse blocks the explanation “he gives to pay someone back.” Reading change: his act becomes radically non-substitutionary and God-oriented.

3. **Soft favor vs scattered individuals.** Evidence: `ن ع م` B002 (softness/easeful living), `ء ح د` B005 (individual-by-individual isolation), activated by 92:4 scattered striving. Structural cue: one purified giver stands amid socially scattered accounts. Mechanism: worldly favors usually soften social life through exchange; here that exchange is absent. Abductive move: I infer that the giver exits the usual network of favor-pressure. Reading change: the ayah presents social solitude as purity, not alienation.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: The later fall of wealth in 92:11 and the fire-contact in 92:15 made the denial feel embodied rather than merely verbal. The milk-failure branch stayed surprisingly useful because several later pastoral/growth branches show false provision drying up against real purification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The human debt ledger is exhaustively cancelled.** `أَحَد` in the negative construction anchors `ء ح د:B002` (exhaustive “anyone”); `عِندَهُ` anchors `ع ن د:B004` (presence or proximity); `نِّعْمَة` anchors `ن ع م:B001` (bestowed favor); and `تُجْزَىٰ` anchors `ج ز ي:B001` (matching recompense) plus `ج ز ي:B003` (collecting a debt). Together they spatialize an exchange account: no favor belonging to any person is present with the giver as a claim to be settled. The ledger model is abductive, but every entry—holder, lodged favor, and repayment—is supplied. The ayah thus negates not gratitude in general but a creditor-like structure governing the gift.

2. **No prior favor can stand in for the true object.** `ج ز ي:B002` contributes standing in, sufficing, or discharging an obligation on another’s behalf. Giving in 92:18 precedes, while the exclusive object of seeking appears in 92:20. This sequence activates a substitution test: a human favor cannot occupy the motivational place reserved for that object. The packet supplies exclusion and succession; the claim that one motive might “stand in” for another is inferred. The ayah reads as protection against motive substitution, not only against literal repayment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The exception in 92:20 identifies the object for which no human favor may substitute, activating `ج ز ي:B002` beyond ordinary repayment. 92:21 then confirms the nontransactional shape: satisfaction still arrives even though the human creditor ledger has been exhaustively negated.

baseline.text: Hiç kimsenin onun yanında karşılığı verilecek bir iyiliği yoktur.

findings.text: Olumsuzlama, vermeyi herhangi bir insanın alacaklı olduğu karşılıklı iyilik hesabından bütünüyle çıkarır.
Hiçbir önceki iyilik, sonraki ayette belirtilen gerçek amacın yerine geçemez; böylece yalnız ödeme değil, güdülerin birbirinin yerini alması da engellenir.
Tek tek yalıtılmış kişiler ve rahatlık sağlayan iyilik boyutları, verenin alışılmış toplumsal iyilik baskısı ağından çıkmasını düşündürür; bu toplumsal yalnızlık okuması zayıftır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek olma, mutlak biçimde eşsiz sayılma ve yinelemeyle bu niteliği pekiştirme çekirdeğini destekler. Aynı ifade saymanın ilk basamağına da değindiği için dal korunabilir, ancak düzenli sayı kurma kullanımları ayrı sayı dalına bırakılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimdeki tek olma anlamını ve yinelemeli pekiştirmeyi ayrı yüzler olarak tutar; yinelemeyi yalın biçimin zorunlu anlamı yapmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın bir tane, tek ya da eşi olmayan olmasıdır; mutlak kullanımda Tanrı'nın ortağı ve benzeri bulunmadığını bildirir. Sözcüğün yinelenmesi bu tekliği güçlü biçimde vurgular.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı bir tane, tek veya eşi bulunmayan olarak gösterir.
Mutlak niteleme olarak kullanıldığında Tanrı'nın ortağı ve benzeri bulunmadığını bildirir.
Aynı sözün art arda yinelenmesi tek olma bildirimini pekiştirir.
Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü saymanın başlangıcındaki bir sayısıyla da ilişkilendirir; düzenli sayı kuruluşları ayrı dalda ele alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi tek olma düşüncesidir. Bu çizgi genel olarak bir tane olmayı, Tanrı için mutlak eşsizliği ve yineleme yoluyla yapılan güçlü vurguyu bir araya getirir; sayı başlangıcına ilişkin kayıt ise komşu sayı dalıyla sınır oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün olumsuzluk içinde konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişilerin bütün türünü kapsadığını ve yalnız tek kişiyi değil iki ya da daha çok kişiyi de dışladığını açıkça belirtir. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın birimin olumsuz cümledeki kapsamına bağlıdır ve başka bir söz öbeğine özgü anlamı bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Olumsuz bir cümlede, söz konusu olabilecek kişilerden bir tekinin bile bulunmadığını ya da eyleme katılmadığını bildirir. Kapsam yalnız bir kişiyi değil, iki ve daha çok kişiyi de dışarıda bırakır.

facets.statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
Bir kişinin yanı sıra iki veya daha çok kişinin varlığını ya da katılımını da dışlar.
Bir yerde hiç kimsenin bulunmadığını veya bir eylemi hiç kimsenin yapmadığını söyleyen cümlelerde gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar olumsuzluk içindeki kullanımın kişi türünü bütünüyle kapsadığı konusunda birleşir. Böylece söz yalnız tek bir kişinin yokluğunu değil, o türe giren herhangi bir sayıda kişinin bulunmamasını da bildirir.

error_profile.loses: Rahat yaşama ve bir başkasını rahat yaşatma yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin rahat ve varlıklı yaşamı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Rahatlık ve bolluk içindeki yaşam yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Fiziksel yumuşama ile başkasını rahat yaşatma yönlerini karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: rahat ve bolluk içinde yaşayan kadın

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Rahat ve bolluk içinde yaşama ile başkasını böyle yaşatma kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kolaylık, hoşgörü ve insanlarla yumuşak davranma gibi toplumsal yönlere uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol fiziksel yumuşaklık ve sertliğin azalması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yumuşaklıktan rahat yaşama ve yaşatmaya uzanır; komşu kol ise kolaylık ve davranış yumuşaklığına kadar genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yumuşama sürecini ve birini rahat yaşam koşullarına kavuşturmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yumuşaklıkla birlikte gürlük ve verimlilik niteliğini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da yumuşaklık ve rahatlık çağrışımında belirgin biçimde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol nitelik bildiren yumuşaklık ve gürlüğe odaklanır; bu kol ayrıca durum değişmesini ve rahat yaşama sürecini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; fiziksel yumuşaklık ile rahat yaşam sınırını en iyi açan iki yakın komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم الشيء إذا لان، والناعم والمنعم والمناعم، والتنعم وطيب العيش والترف، والطعام أو الشخص الموصوف بالنعومة أو الرفاه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم الشيء صار ناعما لينا (sihah)؛ نعمة العيش حسنه وغضارته (tahdhib)؛ نعم فلان أولاده ترفهم (maqayis)؛ طعام ناعم وجارية ناعمة (mufradat)؛ فهو نعم ناعم بين المنعم (ayn)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu yerginin karşısında duran, bir şeyi beğenip öven özel söz ve yapılar olarak açıkça belirler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek başına övgü bildiren biçim ile belirli övgü kalıpları birlikte gösterilir, cevap anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi iyi, güzel veya yerinde bularak onu özel bir söz ya da kalıpla övmek ve beğeniyi bildirmektir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, şey veya davranış hakkında övgü ve beğeni bildirme.
Övgüyü belirli söz dizimsel kalıplarla dile getirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, biçimi yergi bildiren karşıtının karşısına yerleştirir ve hem tek başına hem belirli yapılarda övgü işlevi taşıdığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: övgü ve beğeni bildirmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Tek başına veya özel yapılarda kullanılan övgü işlevinin tamamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi iyi bulma, övme ve beğeniyi sözle bildirme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin doğrudan beğenilip övüldüğü cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrudan beğeni ve övgü bildirme işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her özel övgü yapısının söz dizimsel biçimini tek başına göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi iyi ve beğenilir gösteren övgü kutbunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi kötü ve yerilir gösteren yergi kutbunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir şey hakkında değer yargısını özel bir sözle bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol olumlu değerlendirme ve övgü verir; komşu kol aynı eksenin karşı kutbunda olumsuz değerlendirme ve yergi verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yerginin karşıtı olan genel övgü işlevini ve ona özgü yapıları taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Övgünün yanında güçlü istek ve sevgi derecesini bildiren kullanımlara da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol doğrudan beğeni ve övgü bildiren sözlerde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği yalın övgüdür; komşu kol ise övgüden güçlü istek ve sevgi bildirimine de geçebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; karşıt yergi kutbu ile en yakın övgü sözü sınırı okuyucu için en yararlı iki ayrımdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم المقابلة لبئس، ونعم الشيء، ونعما، وفبها ونعمت، حيث تكون اللفظة فعلا أو صيغة مدح واستحسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم ضد بئس (maqayis)؛ نعم وبئس فعلان ماضيان ... فنعم مدح وبئس ذم (sihah)؛ نعما ... المعنى نعم الشيء هي (tahdhib)؛ نعم كلمة تستعمل في المدح بإزاء بئس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi olumlu cevap, söyleneni doğrulama ve geleceğe dönük söz verme işlevlerini aynı cevap kolunda açıkça birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek başına kullanılan olumlu cevap ile birine olumlu cevap verme yapısı korunur, övgü anlamı içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir soruya olumlu cevap vermek, söylenen bir şeyi doğru diye onaylamak veya istenen bir iş için olumlu söz vermektir.

facets.statement: Soruya veya önermeye olumlu cevap verip onu doğrulama.
Gelecekte yapılacak bir iş için olumlu söz veya güvence verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, bu cevap sözünün olumsuz cevabın karşıtı olduğunu ve soru yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinde kullanıldığını ortak biçimde gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: evet diyerek onaylamak veya söz vermek
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumlu cevap, doğrulama ve olumlu güvence verme işlevlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu cevap verilen veya bir önermenin doğrulandığı konuşmalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu cevap ve doğrulama işlevini doğrudan korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelecekte yapılacak iş için açıkça söz verme yönünü zorunlu olarak göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir isteğe olumlu karşılık verilip geleceğe dönük güvence sunulduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu söz ve işi yapma güvencesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir önermeyi yalnızca doğru diye onaylama işlevini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soru yanıtlamanın yanında olumlu söz ve güvence verme işlevini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle geleceğe ilişkin bir bildirimi doğru diye kabul eden cevap sözüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da konuşmada söyleneni doğru sayan olumlu cevap verir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol doğrulayıcı cevapta yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise genel olumlu yanıtın yanında söz verme işlevine de sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olumlu soruyu veya bildirimi onaylar ve gerektiğinde söz verme işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Olumsuz kurulmuş sözü geri çevirerek karşıt olumlu hükmü doğrular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da konuşmada olumlu hüküm kuran kısa cevap sözleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel onay ve olumlu yanıt verir; komşu kol özellikle önceki olumsuzluğu bozup tersini doğrular.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların hepsi değerlendirildi; genel olumlu cevap ile doğrulayıcı ve olumsuzluğu bozan cevap türleri arasındaki iki sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم حرفا أو كلمة جواب، للتصديق والإيجاب والعدة، وما اتصل بذلك مثل أنعم له أي قال له نعم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم جواب الواجب ضد لا (maqayis)؛ نعم عدة وتصديق وجواب الاستفهام (sihah)؛ نعم يكون تصديقا ويكون عدة (tahdhib)؛ نعم كلمة للإيجاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekil kullanımın özellikle develeri gösterdiğini, çoğul kapsamın ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanlara genişlediğini belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan adlarını kapsar ve başka kollardaki kuş ya da bağış anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Dar kullanımda develeri, daha geniş topluluk adında ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanları gösteren hayvan varlığıdır.

facets.statement: Dar ve belirgin kullanımda develer veya deve malı.
Geniş topluluk adında deve, sığır ve koyunu kapsayan otlayan evcil hayvanlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dar adın deveye özgü veya ağırlıklı olduğunu; geniş adın ise deve, sığır ve koyunla birlikte otlayan evcil hayvanları kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Deveye özgü dar kullanım ile daha geniş hayvan topluluğu kullanımını ayırarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve odağını ve deve, sığır, koyuna genişleyen topluluk kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dar adın özellikle deve varlığını gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dar kapsamdaki deveye özgü hayvan adını korur.
error_profile.loses: Geniş adın sığır ve koyunu da kapsayan topluluk yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve, sığır ve koyunun birlikte kapsandığı geniş kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş topluluk kapsamını ve hayvanların otlayan evcil türler oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bağlam sınırlandırılmazsa kaynak kapsamı dışındaki başka otlayan evcil türleri de düşündürebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geniş kullanımda sığır ve koyunu da deveyle aynı hayvan topluluğuna katar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ergin erkek deveyi, devenin eşini ve develerin sahipleriyle birlikte oluşturduğu sürüyü ayrıntılandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da develeri ve deve varlığını doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol dar adla deveyi, geniş adla birkaç evcil hayvan türünü kapsar; komşu kol devenin cinsiyet, erginlik ve sürü ayrıntılarına odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deveyi merkez alır ve geniş kullanımda sığır ile koyunu birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız koyun ve keçi türünden küçükbaş hayvan topluluğunu cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol evcil ve otlayan hayvanların topluluk adları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol deve merkezli olup daha geniş bir tür dizisine açılır; komşu kol küçükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar tarandı; deve merkezli dar kapsam ile sürü ve küçükbaş topluluğu arasındaki iki karşılaştırma sınırı en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعم والأنعام، خصوصا الإبل، وبالتوسيع الإبل والبقر والغنم والبهائم الراعية حيث نصت المصادر على ذلك.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعم الإبل لما فيه من الخير والنعمة والأنعام البهائم (maqayis)؛ النعم واحد الأنعام وهي المال الراعية وأكثر ما يقع هذا الاسم على الإبل (sihah)؛ النعم لم يريدوا بها إلا الإبل فإذا قالوا الأنعام أرادوا بها الإبل والبقر والغنم (tahdhib)؛ النعم مختص بالإبل وجمعه أنعام (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعامة والنعام للطائر المعروف، ذكرا أو أنثى، وما يذكر من جنسه وصفاته المباشرة.
يدخل فيه المسميات المشبهة بالنعامة في الهيئة أو البعد أو السرعة، مثل خشبة البئر والظلة على رأس الجبل وباطن القدم أو عرق الرجل أو الساق والمحجة والنعائم من منازل القمر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kuş imgeli sözlerin topluluğun dağılması, hızla ayrılması, yol alması, birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesi için kullanıldığını destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtlanan söz kalıplarına bağlanır ve yalın kuş adına dağılma ya da yenilme anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kuş imgeli sözlerde bir topluluğun hızla dağılıp ayrılması, yol alması veya birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun bir arada kalamayarak dağılıp ayrılması veya yola çıkması.
Topluluğun ortak sözünü, gücünü veya saygınlığını yitirmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, kalıplaşmış kuş imgesini toplu ayrılma ve dağılma çekirdeğine bağlar; hızla yol alma, ortaklığın bozulması ve güç kaybı bu çekirdeğin bağlamsal sonuçlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir topluluğun dağılıp gücünü yitirmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan kuş imgeli sözlerdeki dağılma, ayrılma ve güç kaybı alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toplu dağılmayı, ayrılmayı ve buna bağlı güç kaybını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun birliğini kaybedip farklı yönlere ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun dağılması ve ortaklığının bozulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hızlı yol alma kullanımını zorunlu olarak belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dağılmanın yanında ayrılma, hızla yol alma ve güç kaybı sonuçlarını taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle insanların birbirinden farklı yönlere saçılmasını tek bir tarihsel benzetmeyle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir topluluğun birlikten çıkıp farklı yönlere dağılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol yönlere saçılma üzerinde yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise belirli kuş imgeli yapılarda ayrılma ve güç kaybını da kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; farklı yönlere dağılma karşılaştırması kalıbın ayrılma ve güç kaybı sınırını açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه شالت نعامتهم وخفت نعامتهم وأضحوا نعاما ونحوها، حيث يدل التعبير على الارتحال أو التفرق أو ذهاب العز أو الهزيمة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: شالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقوا (maqayis)؛ للقوم إذا ارتحلوا أو تفرقوا قد شالت نعامتهم (sihah)؛ خفت نعامتهم أي استمر بهم السير وشالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقت كلمتهم أو ذهب عزهم (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı güneyden esen, yumuşak, nemli ve öteki rüzgarlara göre daha ıslak bir yel için ortak biçimde kullanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın rüzgar adına aittir ve genel yumuşaklık ya da kuş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneyden esen, esişi yumuşak ve taşıdığı hava nemli olan rüzgardır.

facets.statement: Güney yönünden esen belirli bir rüzgar.
Esişi yumuşak, havası nemli ve ıslaklık taşıyan rüzgar niteliği.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt rüzgarın güney yönünü, yumuşak esişini ve belirgin nemliliğini aynı hava olayı içinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: yumuşak esen nemli güney rüzgarı
concept_gloss.applicability: Yön, esiş biçimi ve nemlilik koşullarının üçünü de açıkça karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güney yönünü, yumuşak esişi ve nemli hava niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgarın yönü ile yumuşak ve nemli hissi birlikte anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güney yönünü ve yumuşak, nemli esiş niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güney rüzgarının yumuşak esişini ve belirgin nemliliğini zorunlu özellik olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Güney rüzgarının esmesi, kişiye ulaşması ve onunla ilişkili bulut gibi daha geniş olayları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da güney yönünden gelen rüzgarı doğrudan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel güney rüzgarının yumuşak ve nemli bir türüdür; komşu kol yönü koruyup esiş niteliğini sınırlamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güney yönünü ve nemli hava niteliğini belirleyici koşul olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hafif yağmuru da kapsar ve rüzgar için belirli bir yön şartı koymaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol yumuşak ve hafif esen rüzgar niteliğinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yönü ve nemi belirli bir rüzgardır; komşu kol yönsüz yumuşak esiş ile hafif yağmuru aynı alanda toplar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm rüzgar ve nem adayları incelendi; genel güney rüzgarı ile yönsüz yumuşak esiş arasındaki iki sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعامى، وهي ريح الجنوب اللينة أو الأرطب والأبل في الهبوب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعامي الريح اللينة (maqayis)؛ النعامى ريح الجنوب لأنها أبل الرياح وأرطبها (sihah)؛ من أسماء الجنوب النعامى (tahdhib)؛ النعامى الريح الجنوب الناعمة الهبوب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir miktarın üzerine çıkma, bir işi daha ileri dereceye götürme ve özellikle öğütmeyi artırma anlamlarını aynı artış çekirdeğinde verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel artırma biçimi ile belirli eylem yapısındaki dereceyi yükseltme kullanımı ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir miktara daha fazlasını eklemek veya bir işi önceki derecesinin ötesine götürerek daha yoğun ve ileri yapmak demektir.

facets.statement: Var olan miktarın üzerine daha fazlasını eklemek.
Bir eylemi daha ileri dereceye götürüp yoğunlaştırmak.
Bir maddeyi daha çok işleyerek daha ince öğütmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, nicelikte fazlalık ekleme ile eylemin derecesini yükseltmeyi aynı artış altında toplar ve daha ince öğütmeyi bunun somut örneği olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: daha da artırmak veya ileri dereceye götürmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nicelik artışını hem bir eylemin yoğunluk derecesinin yükseltilmesini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Fazlalık ekleme ve eylemi daha ileri dereceye götürme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sayı, miktar, söz veya yapılan iş üzerine fazlalık eklendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Var olan miktarın üzerine daha fazlasını ekleme yönünü korur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: جزى يجزي جزاء أي كافأ بالإحسان وبالإساءة (ayn)؛ جزيته بما صنع جزاء وجازيته (sihah)؛ الجزاء يكون ثوابا ويكون عقابا؛ جزيت فلانا بما صنع جزاء؛ جزاء العطاس؛ الجوازي معناها الجزاء (tahdhib)؛ الجزاء ما فيه الكفاية من المقابلة إن خيرا فخير وإن شرا فشر؛ جزيته بكذا وجازيته (mufradat)؛ مكافأته إياه؛ جزيت فلانا أجزيه جزاء وجازيته مجازاة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkasının yerini tutmasını, onun adına işi görmesini ve yeterli olmasını ortak çekirdek olarak verir. İş görme, bir borcu ödeme ve bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması bu çekirdeğin özel uygulamalarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerini tutma ve yeterli olma çekirdeğini genel biçimde verir; kişi, hayvan, iş, borç ve ödeme kalıplarını bu çekirdeğin ayrı uygulamaları olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkasının yerini tutup onun adına bir işi veya yükümlülüğü karşılaması ve yeterli olmasıdır. İş görme, borç ödeme ve bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey ya da kişi başka birinin yerini tutar, onun yerine iş görür ve gereksinimi karşılar.
Bir işin, onu yapması gereken kimse adına tamamlanması yerini tutma çekirdeğinin bir uygulamasıdır.
Birinin alacağını veya borcunu ödemek ya da bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması da aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yerini tutma ile yeterli olmayı tek yapıda birleştirir; başka biri adına iş görme, ödeme yapma ve yükümlülüğü karşılama bu yapının uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: yerini tutup yükümlülüğü karşılama
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkası adına yeterli olması ve gereken işi onun yerine görmesi çekirdeğini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerini tutma, başkası adına iş görme ve yeterli olma bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: onun yerine işi görüp yeterli olma
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin başkasının yerini aldığı ve gereken işi karşıladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının yerini tutma, onun adına iş görme ve yeterli olma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerini tutma çekirdeğinin bir alacak veya borç ödemesiyle gerçekleştiği dar bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yükümlülüğün asıl kişi yerine başkası tarafından karşılanmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ödeme dışındaki işlerde yerini tutma ve genel yeterlilik kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yararlı olma ve gereksinimi karşılama yönünü daha genel biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda bir nesne, ödeme ya da edim de başkasının yerini tutabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca bir kişinin başka bir kişi adına görev üstlenmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bir kişinin başkası adına görev yapması
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin başka birinin yerine geçip onun işini görmesi iki dalda da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kişisel görev üstlenme ortak olsa da odak dalın nesne, ödeme ve yeterli sayılan edimlere uzanan kapsamı komşu dalda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ödemenin veya edimin başka biri ya da şey adına yeterli olup onun yerini tutmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, alacağın ya da emanetin doğrudan ve eksiksiz biçimde ödenmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir borcun veya ödenmesi gereken şeyin yerine getirilmesi iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sırf bir borcu ödemek komşu dala yeter; odak dalda ise ödeme, başka biri adına yeterli sayılma veya onun yerini tutma ilişkisi içinde değerlendirilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir şeyin başkası adına yeterli olup onun yerini tutmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yapılan eylemin iyi ya da kötü bir karşılıkla yanıtlanmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir işin ardından onu karşılayan başka bir edim bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda ikinci edim ilk kişinin yerini tutar veya yükünü karşılar; komşu dalda ise ilk eylemin karşılığıdır ve yerini tutma zorunlu değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşular yeterlilik, kişisel görev üstlenme, doğrudan ödeme ve eyleme karşılık verme sınırlarını birbirinden ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قضاء الشيء عن غيره وقيامه مقامه وكفايته عنه والغناء والحسب وجزاء الحق أو القرض والصدقة التي تجزي عن صاحبها
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلان ذو غناء وجزاء (ayn)؛ جزى عني هذا الأمر أي قضى؛ جزت عنك شاة؛ رجل جازيك أي حسبك (sihah)؛ الجزاء أيضا القضاء؛ لا تقضي فيه نفس عن نفس شيئا؛ جزيت فلانا حقه؛ جزيته قرضه؛ صدقتك جزت عنك؛ هذا رجل حسبك وناهيك وكافيك وجازيك (tahdhib)؛ الجزاء الغناء والكفاية؛ لا يجزي والد عن ولده؛ جازيك فلان أي كافيك (mufradat)؛ قيام الشيء مقام غيره؛ ينوب مناب كل أحد؛ جزى عني هذا الأمر يجزي كما تقول قضى يقضي (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir borcun ödenmesini borçludan istemeyi ve alacağı elde etmeyi açıkça bildirir; aynı kullanım, bunu yapan kimsenin adlandırılmasını da içerir. Bu nedenle geçici çerçeve kaynakla uyumludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, borcu isteme kalıbı ile bu işi yapan kişiyi bildiren biçimi ayrı tutar; bunlardan genel bir çıplak kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir borcun ödenmesini borçludan istemek ve alacağı ondan talep etmektir. Aynı anlam alanı, alacağını isteyen veya borcun ödenmesini talep eden kişi için kullanılan adı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Alacaklı, borçludan borcunu ödemesini ister ve alacağını ondan talep eder.
Borcu isteyen ya da alacağın ödenmesini talep eden kişi bu eyleme bağlı özel bir adla anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, borçludan ödeme isteme anlamında birleşir ve aynı söz varlığının bu işi yapan kişiyi de adlandırdığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: alacağı talep etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir alacaklının borçludan ödeme istemesi veya alacağını talep etmesi anlamındaki kanıtlı bağlamları kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Borcu isteme, borçluya yönelme ve alacağın ödenmesini talep etme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin borçludan ödeme isteme yönünü öne çıkaran bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Alacaklının borçludan ödeme istemesi ve isteğin borca yönelmesi bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Alacaklının borçludan alacağını talep ettiği akıcı kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Alacağı isteme ve talebin borçluya yönelmesi bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: alacağını isteyen veya borcun ödenmesini talep eden kimse

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal borç ve onun alınması çevresinde daha sınırlıdır; komşu dal daha geniş alacak türlerine ve isteği sürdürmeye uzanır.
